summary: Backend smoke 15/15 PASSED (pytest). Frontend ShareComposer full re-test on fresh guest (390x844) — all 3 entry points PASS with 0 console errors. Entry1 (share-progress) via tab-progress → progress-share-button: sheet title 'Bagikan ke Story', share-template + share-streak-count='0' + 'LEVEL PEMULA' badge + 3 stat pills (salat/terbaik/lengkap) rendered; all 4 template chips (langit/burung/tenang/haji) toggle without layout jump; 3 tint buttons (share-style-0/1/2) toggle variants correctly (Langit primary blue / Emas gold); 4 caption chips (share-caption-0..3) switch caption text; share-stats-switch and share-name-switch toggle visibility. On web, share-confirm-button renders as 'Bagikan sebagai teks', triggers Share.share fallback which throws NotAllowedError → catch shows toast 'Berbagi belum tersedia di perangkat ini.' and button correctly re-enabled (busy state reset). Entry2 (success) via prayer-checkin-{subuh|zuhur|asar|magrib}: sheet title 'Satu langkah baik', badge 'SALAT TERCATAT' visible, ShareComposer rendered in completed mode (share-template present). 5th checkin (isya) triggers full-screen level-up overlay directly — dismissed with levelup-continue-button (expected behavior, matches iteration_3). Entry3 (share-verse) via Home daily-share-button: sheet title 'Bagikan ayat', SEAYAT badge, Arabic teksArab + Indonesian translation + 'QS. Ad-Duha : 5' badge rendered; share-stats-switch and share-name-switch are NOT rendered (correct for verse mode). modal-close-button closes sheet in all 3 modes; reopening after close works with fresh state (no stale overlay). Console: 0 errors. No RN red screen. Only pre-existing benign RN-web warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents deprecated) remain.

react_native_issues.issue: Tap component's accessibilityState={{selected}} does not appear to emit aria-selected on RN-web (queried aria-selected returned None). Visual selection state (border color via s.thumbOn) works correctly and template DOES switch. Minor a11y-only issue; not blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ShareComposer.tsx:58
Pre-existing benign RN-web warnings carried over from iter2/iter3. Not blocking. Reference: any StyleSheet with shadow* across /app/frontend/src.

action_items: Optional: ensure Tap component forwards accessibilityState → aria-selected for RN-web (or add aria-pressed manually) so screen readers announce chip selection in ShareComposer. Not required to ship.
No functional action items — ShareComposer works across all 3 entry points with correct web fallback behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareComposer.share() correctly guards with Platform.OS !== 'web' AND Sharing.isAvailableAsync(), and falls back to Share.share on web; try/catch → notify('Berbagi belum tersedia di perangkat ini.') → finally setBusy(false) guarantees loading state resets on any failure (verified live).
GlobalOverlay dispatches ShareComposer for modal.type ∈ {success, share-verse, share-progress} — single source of truth for all 3 entry points, no duplication.
isVerse branch in ShareComposer correctly hides stats/name switches (via `{!isVerse && <switchRow …>}`) and swaps content to verse box with QS badge — verified live for daily-share-button.
completed mode reuses ShareComposer with modal.prayer as headline and 'SALAT TERCATAT' badge; switches remain visible for non-verse per spec — verified.
